examples.text: Я просто хотел спросить про отца.
examples.trans: I just wanted to ask about your father.

examples.trans: Do you have a conscience at all?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тарший'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('older, elder, senior').

examples.trans: As senior chef I declare a break now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ъявлять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'I declare', paired with 'объявить'.

examples.trans: As senior chef I declare a break now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'уметься').

examples.text: Костя сказал это совершенно разуметься и спокойно.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('needed').

meanings.en: actually, strictly speaking, as a matter of fact
